feature: Fix Habit Card Chain Link Alignment & Overlap
description: Fix two visual issues in the habit card: (1) chain link icons not horizontally aligned with header emoji/icon, and (2) chain link connectors overlapping into the habit card boundary.

phases.name: Fix Chain Link Alignment & Overlap
phases.description: Adjust HabitChainVisualizer layout to align with 5-column grid and fix connector overflow

subtasks.description: Fix connector overlap: Adjust connector positioning (lines 579-598) to prevent extending beyond card boundaries. May need to reduce marginLeft/right values or add overflow hidden.
